notes.title: 1.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/348a262cad900fe0c1fff44822fb46aa88271e4f.png
Meet the new Update!

 Killcam - Now you can see your killer. Camera will follow him for 20 seconds after your death.
 Handguns are damaging the Vehicles now. Not so much. But it does.
 Autoreload. Screew the lameness - if you're outta ammo - the gun will reload it self without your help.
 Cars. I've tried to make them more stable. I hope i did XD
 Optimization. Game must run smoother now. In theory...


Share your thoughts!

notes.title: 1.3.33 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/16baed0178d356e1ec7b58183cf96fd4cbe6f7d5.png
It's raining with updates :)
Due to switching-weapon-shooting bug is fixed - all the players are now in the same conditions. So the RPG may come back in all it's glory! But not complete.
It's a anti-vehicle weapon after all.

 Projectile speed and damage are returned to prev parameters
 Lots of smoke is  staying
 AOE damage of RPG is lowered to decrease the damage you take on foot. Direct hit is still deadly enough,

Have a nice killing, comrades!

notes.title: NEW YEAR Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/0864adca4d42e3cc982fe64d8622d74a313dad25.png

Hey guys!
We bring you the New 2022 Year Update.
It contains:

 Vehicles speed is increased
 Avatars speed is increased
 Now you toggle the sprint mode (not hold) with a SHIFT key
 Now you are able to chat safely while piloting the Helicopter
 A little souvenir on your gun
 The Real Holidays spirit!

We wish you to be lucky and healthy in the New Year!

notes.title: Bugfix: increased the amount of experience and silver for the battle, fixed bugs
Game released in early access! Discount in honor of the release - 25%!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are pleased to present you the first working version of our game. From now on, we will conduct the necessary improvements and release updates that will bring the game from the "Early Access" stage to the full release!
Do not forget to write your reviews about the game and share your impressions in the discussions.

notes.title: Release to early access: 02/27/2019!
notes.notes:
Dear players and all who expect our game in the early access!
We practically finished work on the version of the game for early access, but we had to postpone the release date from February 22 to 27, because some things we did not have time to do to this day. Now we confidently declare that the game will be released to early access on February 27 - and this is accurate information!
We will be glad to see everyone in the game!
